complexity_ledger.narrative: CD-07 aligns every remaining user-facing surface with the advisory doctrine and fixes the UX defects the six validation runs catalogued, with zero TLA+ model delta. VAL-04: the scaffold epilog (budgets.budget_prompt) and every generated-manifest budgets comment (new_ticket_workflow.py both manifests, onboard_program_model.py -- the latter found by this ticket's sweep beyond the finding's named sites) now state that budgets are advisory thresholds that warn and never block, with tlc_seconds named as the one hard operational limit; a grep-evidenced sweep (advisory_language_sweep.md) shows zero gate-era budget language in scaffold output and classifies every remaining 'hard gate' occurrence as by-design non-budget (corpus caps, MF-015 channels, experimental kill floor), superseded historical narrative, or immutable record. VAL-01: fitness_functions.load_rules detects PyYAML absence before validating a manifest-embedded rules block and emits the documented advisory CONFIG ERROR naming PyYAML and the fitness_functions.json alternative (verified against the real CLI under this machine's yaml-less python3, exit 0; regression test simulates absence via sys.modules). VAL-02: kill_rate_floor and max_symmetric_instances are excluded from the missing-budgets warning (EXPERIMENTAL_BUDGET_KEYS) while keeping documented defaults so kill_test stays functional; a per-docs manifest scans with empty stderr. CD-02-DF-01: analyze() no longer feeds a Path('does-not-exist') sentinel to load_budgets -- the no-manifest warning states what happened. VAL-05: the justification-table schema (mapping per variable, non-empty invariants/effects/kill_tests lists, prose is not linkage) is documented in architecture_tractability.md and as a comment in every scaffolded manifest. VAL-03: run_tlc.sh points TLC -metadir at a mktemp dir removed by an EXIT trap; the ticket TLC run leaves no states/ residue. VAL-15: complexity_intuition.md gains 'The write-only-state test' -- a write-only stamped variable is bookkeeping unless a nameable dependent (guard, invariant beyond type, test, or reader) exists; stated design intent is not a reader -- worked from the recorded ex3-run1 vs ex3-run2 divergence, blessing run 1's classification as canonical while separating classification from production-refactor authorization. CD-06-DF-01 (inherited): action_count fact description corrected in FACT_DOCS and the reference catalog. Validation: TLC green (283,805 distinct within max_distinct_states 500,000, rationale carried through desired/), spec-unit 2 targets green, 601 repo tests, specWorkflow and cliWorkflow green.

ticket.objective: Resolves VAL-04, VAL-01, VAL-02, VAL-03, VAL-05, CD-02-DF-01, VAL-15. (1) VAL-04: the scaffold-project epilog and generated manifest comment still say "Budgets are hard gates" (new_ticket_workflow.py ~615/~666) — reword to the advisory doctrine every other surface states. (2) VAL-01: manifest-embedded fitness rules under bare python3 go through the fallback manifest parser and surface as a misleading INVALID (flow-style leaves mangled to '{fact'); emit the documented advisory CONFIG ERROR naming missing PyYAML and the fitness_functions.json alternative instead. (3) VAL-02: drop the retired fuzzing-era keys (kill_rate_floor, max_symmetric_instances) from the required-budgets warning set or gate them behind the experimental surface. (4) CD-02-DF-01: the no-manifest warning prints a literal does-not-exist sentinel path — say what happened instead. (5) VAL-05: document the justification-table schema (dict with non-empty invariants/effects/kill_tests lists) where agents look. (6) VAL-03: run_tlc.sh leaves a TLC states/ scratch dir inside the target spec dir — point the metadir at a temp location or clean up. (7) VAL-15: sharpen complexity_intuition.md's example-3 vs example-5 boundary for write-only stamped state, using the recorded ex3 run-1 vs run-2 divergence as the worked case (a test such as: if no guard, invariant, test, or reader depends on it, it is bookkeeping regardless of stated design intent — or explicitly bless both outcomes and name the evidence that separates them).
